newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges higher on trades, swaps flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges higher on trades, swaps flat.

text.p: European gasoline barge levels showed further significant gains Tuesday, although earlier swap gains were largely last in a lackluster afternoon of trading.

Two Eurograde barge trades were seen done earlier in the afternoon at $194.50 for balance-of-July, well above the two morning deals at $192 and a single deal at $193 and a clear rise from the $190-$193 bid-offer range registered by late Monday.
The gains were seen related to poor refinery avails at a time of reasonable demand in both the north and the Med, dealers said.

August swap values, however, having hit $190 after morning deals at $190 and $190.25, fell back by late afternoon to $188.50-$190, virtually unchanged on the day, as September backwardation grew to $4.50 and October to $5 behind September.
